Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 28

“Beings are unmanifest in their beginnings, manifest in the middle state, and unmanifest again at their end, Bharata. What is there to lament in this?”

A life is presented as a brief visible stretch between two invisibilities. Krishna is not minimizing the middle; he is asking why its entirely predictable ending should arrive as an outrage.
